content: After performing entity linking to the input text using the ELS, we receive a sequential list of linked entities, arranged based on their location in the text. We embed these entities to $d$ -dimensional vectors $E = \lbrace e_1, e_2, ..., e_m\rbrace $ where $e_i \in \mathbb {R}^d$ . Since these entities may still contain ambiguity, it is necessary to resolve them before applying them to the base model. Based on the idea that an ambiguous entity can be disambiguated using its neighboring entities, we introduce two kinds of disambiguating encoders below.
